name: go_logging_side_effect
prompt:
Fix the Go logging side effect bug.

Requirements:
- Modify signup.go only.
- ProcessSignup must reject blank email addresses.
- ProcessSignup must reject email addresses without @.
- Failed signups must not write to the logger.
- Successful signups must write exactly one log entry.
- Successful log entries must use the trimmed email address.
- Do not modify main.go, logger.go, or go.mod.
- Do not create new files.
- Use patch_candidate if only ProcessSignup changes.
- Use patch_plan if imports in signup.go must change.
- target_snippet must be copied verbatim from the actual file.

Validation command: go run .
